summary.para: An object describing a single document to extract the content from.
The format of the document. If not specified, this defaults to base64 for pdf and image, and url for html. The html type supports url only. Not all services and models support all formats.
The type of the document. Not all services and models support all types.

The value of the document. For the base64 format, this must be a base64-encoded data URI, that is, "data:content/type;base64,...". For the url format, this must be a URL that points to the document, that is, "https://example.com/document.pdf".
